raw_segments.text: The sun was high up and beginning to bite. The swift breeze seemed to Edna to bury the
sting of it into the pores of her face and hands. Robert held his umbrella over her.
As they went cutting sideways through the water, the sails bellied taut, with the wind
filling and overflowing them. Old Monsieur Fareville laughed sardonically at something
as he looked at the sails, and Beaudellet swore at the old man under his breath.
